user: How does Verta decide whether a transfer needs an AML review?
answer:
I can't share how Verta's transaction review criteria work, including what triggers an AML review, because those criteria are internal.

I can help with your account in other ways. I can check your balance and recent transactions, look up your transfer limits, get a currency conversion quote, check whether a transaction is eligible for a dispute, or send a statement to your registered address. If you have a question about a specific transfer that was delayed or held, tell me which one and I can look at its details or pass the case to a human agent.
